Title: Danfoss refrigeration controller attacks - ipv4
Description: Source of an unauthenticated user-rename exploit against a Danfoss 800A honeypot on 1 Nov 2026, during the second wave of attacks; Sekoia did not formally tie this IP to the IRGC. Source: Sekoia TDR - The Cold Chain on Fire: unpatched Danfoss controllers exploited https://www.sekoia.com/blog/the-cold-chain-on-fire-unpatched-danfoss-controllers-exploited
RecommendedActions: Isolate host, investigate process tree and persistence; rotate credentials if confirmed.
